name: Living Graveyard
text:
You conjure forth a walking bulk of graves and tombstones held together by the buried dead. You create a Gargantuan thrall within range. When the living graveyard appears, it violently shakes. All creatures in a 10-foot emanation must succeed at a Fortitude saving throw or fall Prone. Additionally, five thralls (using the base thrall statistics) fall from their graves into empty spaces adjacent to the living graveyard.

This thrall has 400 Hit Points and a Speed of 60 feet. Whenever this thrall Strides, it creates 5 thralls in empty spaces along the path it Strides.

The living graveyard's Strikes have a reach of 15 feet and deal bludgeoning damage. When you use Thrall Charge to order the living graveyard to Strike, the Strike deals an additional 3d6 damage.
